open_items: Explicit user decision BOOTSTRAP-SNAPSHOT-715 replaces the former atomic rollback/replay oracle. Full 18.v implementation and its separate Apply gates remain open.
Historical tests/evidence remain bound to their original contract; no prior result proves this new guarantee.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad init` MUSS vor dauerhaftem Schutzbeginn bei Fehlern den unveränderten Ausgangszustand erhalten; ab Schutzbeginn MUSS ein fehlgeschlagener oder unterbrochener Bootstrap seinen tatsächlichen Bestand gesperrt erhalten, ohne Rücknahme oder Vervollständigung. Erfolg setzt die vollständig geprüfte und dauerhaft abgeschlossene Grundstruktur voraus; ein neuer Bootstrap nach Abbruch benötigt ein anderes zulässiges Ziel nach 10.7.2.
oracle.scope: Bootstrap protection before target effects, preserved blocked partial state after protection; no rollback/replay. Actual implementation and Apply acceptance remain pending in 18.v.

preconditions: Owned temporary directories; native Linux descriptor-relative reads, inode flock and renameat2 no-replace publication. Built module/zipapp cases use actual independently built distribution bytes in fresh isolated processes.
steps: Execute native init and bundle extraction on their allowed missing/existing targets; compare complete actual configuration, document, resources, bundle payload and retained foreign bytes.

Before durable protection, refuse invalid input/collision without target changes. After protection, preserve the actual partial bytes and ownership markers; never roll back, finish or reuse the interrupted target.

Kill a real isolated process at publication boundaries. Refuse all normal reentry, even when configuration is absent or target publication is already complete; an independently chosen permissible new root may be created.

Reject altered/incomplete marker pairs, mismatching owners, unsafe links and changed inputs or target inventory. Successful original completion removes only its own marker after full native verification; completed passive receipt reads never publish files.
